title: Tooling: exact helper-donor cold-kernel search — rediscovers #1297's kernels, census on #1305/#1324 words (no new kappa)
head: a668059ec7df16192e91e02b33616d64b52f6e72
body:
Adds `research/helper-donor-kernel-search/`, the first published search tool for the helper-donor cold-kernel mechanism. That mechanism was introduced by #1274 (pivot 531) and extended by #1286/#1297; it is the largest local gain on the X54 line. **No new κ.**

## How the search works
For every write `p += k·Y` that has earlier reads of p, the tool:
- deletes a subset of those early reads;
- cancels p through Y at a cut, with an early-cleanup tail restore;
- computes the exact program-map change D mod 2³¹−19;
- solves a single-donor relation `q·v_hook = −D` with dyadic q;
- prices each candidate exactly with #1186's frame solver.

## Results
- **Positive control.** On #1218's word (no kernel yet), the tool rediscovers #1297's pivot-555 kernel exactly: delete reads 466/502/734, donor 620 with coefficient 2 at hook 112, cost −11,676, profile H1 −3, H3 +1. It also finds the five equivalent donor hooks.
- **Census.** On #1305's final words, which #1324 (the current best claim) uses unchanged, I searched every register and write: 1,048 write instances per word, both words. **No further single-donor kernel exists.** Further local gains need two-donor relations or other cancel forms; see Open next questions.
- **Negative control.** The already-applied pivot 555 gives no gain.

## Reproduce
```sh
python3 -B research/helper-donor-kernel-search/verify.py --toolkit <PR1186>/research/exact-frame-toolkit   # ~1 min
```
Output: `PASS_HELPER_DONOR_KERNEL_SEARCH_CONTROLS`. Inputs are vendored and pinned: #1305 `a96a5d95` and #1218 `0aa14797`.

A candidate the tool finds is nomination data, not an admitted construction. All inherited conditions remain.
